edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender for WAGMI.transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.

require(msg.sender == owner) gates list.
owner is assigned from tx.origin in the constructor, making the deployer the privileged account.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
checkBots modifier executes its external call before the transferFrom body and state updates.
checkBots performs a low-level external call to the attacker-influenced botProtection contract.
botProtection can re-enter transferFrom before balances and allowances are updated.
transfer simply forwards to transferFrom.

transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
approve writes unlimited or arbitrary values into the allowance mapping.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
The delegatecall target executes in the contract storage context and can re-enter.
The owner check controls who may trigger the delegatecall.
distribute makes a low-level external call to botProtection.
botProtection can re-enter distribute while balances are being rewritten.
distribute overwrites arbitrary entries in the balanceOf mapping.
distribute requires msg.sender to be the owner.
list performs a low-level external call to botProtection before finishing distribution.
botProtection can re-enter list during state mutation.
list performs an external payable call to the Uniswap router.
The router interaction occurs before the distribution loop, allowing re-entrancy into list.
list writes owner, contract and recipient balances.
list requires msg.sender to be the owner.
list calls addLiquidityETH on uniRouter.
